hero.subtitle_line2: I'm currently learning OpenGL, and at this stage I plan to learn Vulkan and then build a multi-backend rendering engine.
hero.subtitle_line3: In the future, I plan to refactor my WarShips project and build a new 2D side-scrolling combat game with SDL.
hero.subtitle_line4: If you're interested in collaborating on development, feel free to reach out.

warships.title: WarShips
warships.desc: A tactical naval battle board-game project designed to practice more engineering-oriented architecture and multiple design patterns, improving maintainability and extensibility.

minesweeper.title: MineSweeper
minesweeper.desc: My first attempt at building an OOP-structured project: I implemented a Scene Manager to drive and switch scenes in a unified way, and built core components such as a Button class and a Board class.

pathfindingvisualizer.title: PathFindingVisualizer
pathfindingvisualizer.desc: A visualization project page for pathfinding algorithms, including implementations and visual demonstrations of A*, Dijkstra, BFS, DFS, and more. It also supports dynamically adding obstacles and adjusting algorithm parameters to observe the performance of different algorithms.

microcomputer.title: 74xx 8-bit Microcomputer
microcomputer.desc: A Turing-complete 8-bit microcomputer built from 74-series TTL chips, featuring a custom ISA, program counter/address registers, and a simple memory + I/O system.

softrenderer.title: SoftRenderer
softrenderer.desc: A CPU-based C++ software renderer that implements a simplified graphics pipeline, including vertex processing, triangle rasterization, fragment shading, and texture sampling. It also integrates a Dear ImGui backend adapted to the current pipeline for runtime debugging, performance statistics, and rendering bottleneck analysis. The project is currently in a long-term performance optimization phase.

takemetoballgame.title: Take me  to  ballgame.
takemetoballgame.desc: An MLB stadium trip-planning project built with Qt Widgets + SQLite, where I was responsible for the overall architecture and the app's backend-layer implementation.

buttonsdl.title: ButtonForSDL
buttonsdl.desc: I extracted a reusable Button class from the project and performed a series of refactors to make interaction logic clearer and improve maintainability.

about.summary_text: I’m a CS student currently focusing on C++ and computer graphics, with strong interests in game programming and real-time rendering. Rather than simply calling black-box APIs, I prefer understanding the underlying implementation details. My goal is to build a multi-backend 3D rendering engine that supports OpenGL, Vulkan, and a self-developed software rasterizer backend, while gradually improving dynamic model loading, real-time light adjustment, skeletal animation playback and control, the material system, scene management, and debugging tools.
